title: attention sparsity mapper and KV bucket rebalancer for MQA/GQA tail-latency smoothing
author: Priya Nambiar
description: Summary: Introduces an attention sparsity mapper that detects per-head and per-layer sparsity patterns at runtime and routes attention kernels to sparsity-optimized codepaths; adds a KV bucket rebalancer that keeps KV-shard occupancy balanced across GPU lanes and proactively migrates small cold-buckets into contiguous slabs to avoid fragmentation. Motivation: MQA/GQA model modes (mixed head widths and grouped attention) produce pathological per-head allocation and microburst patterns that increase p99 latency and cause uneven kernel selection leading to suboptimal GPU utilization. This PR implements two complimentary mechanisms to address these issues: (1) a lightweight runtime mapper that tags requests with a sparsity profile (head-density histogram + token alignment fingerprint) and biases kernel selection towards sparse-friendly kernels when beneficial; (2) a background KV bucket rebalance worker that runs during idle cycles and reclaims fragmented KV slots, coalesces tiny buckets, and pre-warms likely-cold buckets for models with high short-burst variance. Key changes: new runtime/attn/sparsity_mapper.{cpp,h} and runtime/kv/kv_rebalancer.{cpp,h}; scheduler hooks to honor sparsity hints during kernel dispatch; a new continuous-batching window guard that prevents microbursts from breaking batch packing for short-lived interactive sessions; feature flag gating (feature_flags.yaml) and operator-config knobs for rebalance aggressiveness and CPU/GPU resource limits. Benchmarks: end-to-end canary on Dedicated (8xA100 equivalent): Llama-MQA 13B, 8k context: p50 -6.1% latency, p95 -9.4%, p99 -18% (tail wins); throughput +7.8% for steady streams; Qwen-34B GQA mode: p99 -15% under bursty traffic with 16-token microbursts; reduced kernel fallback rate by 62% on average across 50k test traces. Backwards compatibility and safety: default behavior is off; rollout via feature flag; KV rebalance is read-only until operator enables migration mode. Rollout plan: step 1 canary in Hosted in eu-west-1 with small percentage of traffic (1%), monitor p50/p95/p99, kernel fallback rate, KV fragmentation metric; step 2 expand to Dedicated pools with opt-in; step 3 enable background migration for Private with operator approval. Testing: unit tests for mapper heuristics and rebalance FSM, synthetic replay tests with recorded production traces, end-to-end perf jobs run in nightly cluster, additional integration tests to ensure no data corruption during movable KV operations. Related work: builds on prior KV compactor work and head-tiling heuristics but focuses on runtime detection and live rebalancing rather than offline packing. Rollback: disable flags and revert head_branch; extensive observability added to trace kernel choice, sparsity fingerprint, and rebalance actions. Migration notes: for Private deployments operators should disable migration until maintenance window is scheduled. See linked Linear ENG-3491 for perf goals and ENG-3627 for rollout checklist.

review_comments: Ethan Zhao: Nice focused split. Two high level asks: (1) can the sparsity fingerprint be computed in the fast path without extra allocations? (2) add a safety net to avoid rebalance thrashing if the model has extreme churn.

Priya Nambiar: Responded: fingerprint uses stack-allocated fixed buffer and is computed during tokenization hook; rebalance uses exponential backoff and a throttle window per model shard to avoid thrash.
Lars Håkansson: Please add an integration test that runs with synthetic microbursts and validates no data loss during migration.
Priya Nambiar: Added tests/kv/kv_rebalance_fsm_test.py with a migration dry-run mode; confirmed no corruption on CI and on nightly cluster.
Miguel Ortega: Observability looks good, but add a histogram for 'rebalance_moved_bytes' and a boolean gauge 'rebalance_in_progress' for alerting.
Priya Nambiar: Added metrics and dashboard snippet to observability/metrics.
Ethan Zhao: Approve after small docs tweak.

release_notes: Introduce attention sparsity mapper and KV bucket rebalancer. Opt-in feature flags default to disabled; expected p99 reductions on MQA/GQA models and improved kernel selection for sparse heads. Operators: review rebalance config before enabling migration in Private deployments.
notes_for_ops: Default off. Flags: runtime.attn.sparsity_mapper.enabled, runtime.kv.rebalancer.mode={dry,rebalance,migrate}, runtime.kv.rebalancer.cpu_limit, runtime.kv.rebalancer.gpu_warmup_budget. Migration must be scheduled in maintenance window for air-gapped installs.
testing_summary: Unit tests + synthetic trace replay + nightly end-to-end perf runs. Canary reduced p99 for target models; full rollout gated on canary metrics.
